summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package impersonates the upstream `rollup-plugin-postcss` (ships EGOIST's original author metadata, repository URL, CHANGELOG, and dist/index.js verbatim) under the @ornikar corporate scope, but adds a `preinstall: node setup.mjs` lifecycle hook not present in the legitimate project. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a temp directory, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})` against a sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-CommonJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using a character-code / string-array decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`) and obfuscated identifiers; it is not referenced from dist/index.js and is unrelated to the advertised rollup/PostCSS plugin functionality. The alternate-runtime execution path causes the obfuscated payload to run under Bun rather than Node so that Node-only supply-chain scanners do not observe its behavior at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
